changelog: Bug 1 (regression from v3.22.5): dragging the price axis to rescale it did nothing -- v3.22.5 Fix A's own nudge called priceScale().applyOptions({autoScale:true}) on EVERY render pass (every mousemove/redraw), forcing autoScale back on the instant the trader's drag turned it off. Replaced with btMaybeNudgeAutoScale(): a signature of every open position/pending order/ticket's own entry+stop+take-profit is tracked, and the nudge now only fires when that signature actually changes (a trade opened/closed, an order placed/filled/cancelled, the ticket opened/edited, or a level dragged) -- never on a plain redraw. A manual scale (detected by observing autoScale go false, which this codebase never sets directly) is respected from then on, except a brand-new open position/pending order still forces one re-enable ('levels always in view on entry' is the v3.22.5 requirement). Two ways back to auto: double-clicking the axis (Lightweight Charts' own native reset -- confirmed our capture-phase listeners don't swallow it) and a new bottom-right 'A' toggle, highlighted while auto is on. Also hardened: the capture-phase mousedown/dblclick/contextmenu listeners on .tv-chart-wrap now explicitly ignore the price-scale and time-scale axis strips (btEventInPlotArea()) -- closes a latent gap where a horizontal_line/horizontal_ray's own deliberately x-unbounded hit-test could have claimed a click landing on its own y anywhere along the chart, including over the axis.

Bug 2: two trades closing on the same bar (the duplicate longs #132/#134) drew their exit-reason pills at the identical spot, overlapping so badly the second one's text rendered over the first's ('-1.00R SL' read as '00R SL'). btDrawClosedTradeMarkers() now groups closed trades by their exact time_out (settleTrade() stores this as the closing bar's own time, so two trades genuinely closed on the same bar always share it) and stacks that bar's own exit pills top-to-bottom with a 4px gap whenever they'd otherwise overlap -- a single trade on a bar renders pixel-identical to before this fix.
release_notes: No schema change this release -- db_migrations is empty, deploy is Update Now + a hard refresh (Ctrl+Shift+R). New harness driver tools/ui-harness/drive-v3226.mjs covers both bugs against the existing stateful mock sessions (20 fresh, 21 pre-seeded with the real #132/#134 shape) -- a real mouse drag on the price axis via Playwright, holding through 20 Next Bar steps + mouse moves, both double-click and 'A'-button resets, a new trade forcing the override while manually scaled, and a direct canvas pixel-position check (not just a screenshot) that the two same-bar pills land 26px apart. drive.mjs, drive-v3223.mjs and drive-v3225.mjs all still pass unmodified. php -l and node --check clean on every changed file; duplicate-name scan clean. The risk-ladder engine, previously slated as v3.22.6, is now v3.22.7.
